jobs.description: What is Finary? Money is broken: most people’s wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see. We are putting a private banker in everyone’s pocket, with the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client. Mounir launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us. Finary AI turns that context into a plan, and our investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real. Why now? AI makes this possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy: years of per-user financial data that no public dataset holds, a brand that brings in half of our new users through our own channels, and licences (PSAN, Investment Firm, MiCA) we secured before they became mandatory. In 2021, when a simple registration was enough to offer crypto in France, we chose to build fully regulated. Today Finary is a crypto-asset service provider under MiCA, an investment firm, a payment institution and an insurance broker. Very few European platforms hold that combination. Our compliance team is organised by role, not by product: compliance officer, AML, senior advisory and control. Each role covers every licence. Reporting to our Head of Compliance, who is our AML/CFT officer, you'll work alongside our AML analyst and take ownership of the framework that protects our clients and our licences, with most of our exposure in crypto. jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Private Banking Relationship Manager Key Responsibilities: Build and manage long-term relationships with High Net Worth Individuals (HNWIs) and affluent clients Provide tailored wealth management, investment, and financial planning solutions aligned with clients financial goals Grow Assets Under Management (AUM) through portfolio development, client acquisition, and relationship expansion Deliver holistic advisory services across investment, protection, and wealth preservation solutions Identify new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market engagement Maintain the highest standards of client service, professionalism, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance Requirements: Bachelor s Degree (S1) from any discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Priority Banking
